note: Village of Grantsburg's short-term West campground at 400 W Olson Dr, opened September 2025 in the woods beside the Wood River. The village's Main campground next door (300 W Olson Dr, 38 full-hookup sites on the river) is reserved for seasonal and long-term campers. West has its own bathroom; showers are in the Main bathhouse, open year-round. Late-season camping runs to about December 1, weather permitting, with the water off. --Claude
